title: Paneer Masala
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        Paneer

        Tomatoes

        onion

        red chilli powder 

        coriander powder

        cumin powder

        turmeric powder

        garam masala

        How to prepare
        In a pan add some oil  then add 1 onion, 3 tomatoes and some salt and fry for 2 minutes
        now add some red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, ginger garlic paste
        fry until tomatoes and onions are cooked well and now keep them aside and let it cool .
        Now in a mixer grinder add the fried items and grind it into paste.
        In a pan add 2 tablespoon of oil add some cumin seed and ground paste then fry for 2 minutes
        now add fried paneer into the mixture and bring it into a boil add some garam masla and heavy cream and salt to taste and serve
        this with hot rotis and naan or some hot rice.
